segments.an7.3:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme … pe … sattimāni, bhikkhave, balāni.
segments.an7.3:1.5: Saddhābalaṃ, vīriyabalaṃ, hirībalaṃ, ottappabalaṃ, satibalaṃ, samādhibalaṃ, paññābalaṃ.
segments.an7.3:2.1: “Saddhābalaṃ vīriyañca, hirī [hiri (sī. pī. ka.)] ottappiyaṃ balaṃ;
segments.an7.3:2.3: Satibalaṃ samādhi ca, paññā ve sattamaṃ balaṃ;
segments.an7.3:2.5: Etehi balavā bhikkhu, sukhaṃ jīvati paṇḍito;

lines: Tatiye yoniso vicine dhammanti upāyena catusaccadhammaṃ vicināti.
Vimokkho hoti cetasoti tassa imehi balehi samannāgatassa khīṇāsavassa dīpanibbānaṃ viya carimakacittassa vatthārammaṇehi vimokkho hoti, gataṭṭhānaṃ na paññāyati.
